forensic_summary.trigger: Concurrent 'No-Bid' Supply Chain Crisis (Kwanta) and 'Banana Defect' Thermal Failure (Jetcrown) during Pilot

war_stories.label: The Banana Defect
war_stories.description: Engineered 'Method A' Vertical Hanging Fixture to utilize gravity against glass-transition sag during rubberized paint cure cycle.

war_stories.label: The No-Bid Shock
war_stories.description: Engaged domestic vendor Mass Precision for manual offset welding to bridge Pilot when overseas automation failed due to standoff density.

war_stories.label: The Trap Door Protocol
war_stories.description: Emergency redesign of front bolster to create recessed access for headphone jack, converting RTF liability to Field Replaceable Unit.

events.snippet: Initiated project by requesting legacy Control 24 unit to 'take apart and study'.
Initial surface design drawn and PRD written; sent to mechanical for COGS estimate.
Strategic decision: Abandon membrane switches for 'living-hinge' design; limit sheet metal to 39".
Released 'curtis_RC1_02_22_06.ai' artwork file to ID lead.
Cancelled construction review to prioritize release of Data Control Drawings (DCDs).
Released all internal small plastic parts to tooling.
Phase 1 Exit Review completed.
CRITICAL: Primary vendor Kwanta 'No-Bid' the Top Panel due to standoff density.
Authorized Mass Precision to use offset welder for emergency manual sheet metal bridge.

events.snippet: Pilot Run started.
Thermal failure: Side Caps 'unfit' due to mold/cure issues.
Pilot Build Issues: Parts not straight, missing countersinks, paint cure time failure.
Vendor admits 'bow' due to paint cure effect; lack of curing fixture identified.
Photo evidence: Gap check reveals significant shrinkage/interference in plastic fit.
Status Report: RTM complete 8/16; Pilot scheduled 8/22.
Project Status: 'At Risk'. Production start targeted for 9/28 missed.
Project Status recovered: 'On Schedule'. FCS set for 11/7.
Submitted ECOs for plastic parts (Sidecaps, Bolster, Meter Lens).
Finalized ECO 13707; planning transition for next year.
